title: Steward credential disposition record (v3)
description: One independently verified disposition for one credential-shaped finding (#2283). Stored at founder/steward/security-dispositions/<debt-short-id>-<fingerprint>-<occurrence>.json. Bound to the finding (path, pattern, fingerprint, occurrence among identical tokens in the file, stable source context hash), not to the whole file: an unrelated edit does not reopen it, a changed token or line does. v3 binds to source context (v2: line only; v1: whole file); older records are rejected. The consumer (src/gaia_cli/steward/credentialDispositions.py) additionally requires verifiedBy to differ from author, exactly one claimant per finding, and the ruling and policy decision records to be decided and accepted by the desk validator.

debtId.description: The file's stable credential_leak debt id.

line.description: Informational: the line at review time. Not part of identity.

occurrence.description: Required. A record without it is malformed and counts as an ambiguous claim on every occurrence. Index among live findings in the file sharing this pattern and fingerprint.

verifiedBy.description: Independent verifier agent id. Must equal verifierAgentId of the committed receipt named by verificationReceipt; never self-asserted.

verificationReceipt.description: Id of a receipt in founder/steward/security-dispositions/receipts/, written only by the lead's integrate step from a recorded agent.verify outcome. The receipt's builder must equal author, its verifier must equal verifiedBy and differ from the builder, and it must list this record's reviewed-content sha256 (scripts/steward_credential_disposition.py hash).

contextSha256.description: Hash of the finding's stable source context: its line, the two non-blank lines either side, and the chain of enclosing less-indented block headers. Only edge ASCII whitespace and CR/LF are ignored. A change inside the line, a move to another scope, or an edit within the window reopens the finding. Identical occurrences sharing pattern, fingerprint and context are never decided.
